title: 第21章 何以为家第22章 少女登门
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第21章何以为家
江尘眼眶有些发热，前世他很小时候父母就离婚了，各自组建了新家庭，他几乎没怎么体会过家的感觉。
反倒是穿越之后，老爹和兄长给了他一种家的感觉。
江尘尬笑两声：“爹，我这不是怕遭雷劈吗？”
“呵，雷要是想劈你，早就劈死你了。”
江有林感觉搓得差不多了，才将江尘的脚按进木盆中。
热水一泡，江尘才感觉双脚渐渐恢复知觉。
“呼！”
江尘在盆里搓了搓脚，才开口问道：“嫂子，怎么这么快就有热水了？”
“刚做完饭，灶里本来就温有水。
江能文回来跟我说烧热水，我就赶紧添了把柴。”
这时候，柴火金贵得很。
每次做完饭后，都会在锅里加上几瓢水，用剩下的热气把水温热，用来洗漱再好不过。
这时，江田也跟了进来，将肩膀上的大鱼往地上一放，发出“啪”
的一声响。
“哇！
好大的鱼！”
随之，院子里传来了江晓芸的惊叹声。
“我都说了，比我还大的鱼！”
江能文声音极为兴奋。

又有肉吃了，明天还能跟小伙伴讲讲鱼肉是什么味道。
陈巧翠跟着出去，看着躺在地上已经冻得有些发硬的草鱼。
顿时眉飞色舞，回头发问：“二郎，这是你抓的？”
“昂，费了些劲。”
其实没怎么费劲，那鱼本就快死了，是他太兴奋，往前多踏了一步才弄湿了靴子。
“这下好了，过冬的肉都有了！”
陈巧翠兴奋得不能自已。
在这儿，鱼肉算是最便宜的肉类了.
虽然不算太好吃，但也是寻常百姓过年时能吃上的少数几种肉之一。
能吃上鱼肉，才算是“年年有余”
了。
前几天她为了尽早给江尘说个媳妇儿，免不了有些夸大江尘的本事。
可今天这么一闹，谁都知道江尘是个有本事的了！
甚至她之前说的，都还显得有些不够了。
江有林面色却有些严厉：“冬天抓鱼，你简直是太疯了！
金石潭那边，稍有不慎可就真的没命了。”
content_en:
Chapter 21 Why Home?
Jiang Chen's eyes were a little hot. In his previous life, his parents divorced when he was very young, and each of them started a new family. He hardly experienced the feeling of playing at home.
On the contrary, after traveling through time, his father and brother gave him a feeling of home.
Jiang Chen laughed awkwardly: "Dad, aren't I afraid of being struck by lightning?"
"Oh, if thunder wanted to hit you, it would have killed you long ago."
Jiang Youlin felt that the rubbing was almost done, and then he pressed Jiang Chen's feet into the wooden basin.
After soaking in hot water, Jiang Chen felt his feet gradually regaining consciousness.
"Phew!"
Jiang Chen rubbed his feet in the basin and then asked, "Sister-in-law, why did you get hot water so quickly?"
"I just finished cooking, and there was already warm water in the stove.
Jiang Nengwen came back and told me to boil hot water, so I quickly added some firewood. "
At this time, firewood was very expensive.
Every time after cooking, I would add a few ladles of water to the pot and use the remaining heat to warm the water, which is perfect for washing.
At this time, Jiang Tian also followed in, put the big fish on his shoulder on the ground, and made a "pop!"
A sound.
"Wow!
What a big fish! "
Then, Jiang Xiaoyun's exclamation came from the yard.
"I told you, there's a fish bigger than me!"
Jiang Nengwen's voice was extremely excited.
I have eaten meat again, and I can tell my friends what fish tastes like tomorrow.
Chen Qiaocui followed him out and looked at the grass carp lying on the ground, which was already stiff from the cold.
Immediately his eyebrows were flying, he turned around and asked: "Erlang, you caught this?"
"Ang, it took some effort."
In fact, it didn't take much effort. The fish was almost dead. He was so excited that he took an extra step forward and wet his boots.
"It's good now, we have all the meat for the winter!"
Chen Qiaocui was so excited that she couldn't help herself.
Here, fish is the cheapest meat.
Although it is not very delicious, it is one of the few types of meat that ordinary people can eat during the Chinese New Year.
Only if you can eat fish can you be considered to have "more than enough every year"
.
A few days ago, in order to find a wife for Jiang Chen as soon as possible, she inevitably exaggerated Jiang Chen's abilities.
But after such a fuss today, everyone knows that Jiang Chen is capable!
Even what she said before seemed a little insufficient.
Jiang Youlin looked a little stern: "You are so crazy about catching fish in winter!
Over at Jinshitan, if you are not careful, you will really die. "
